senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (जटति)
To clot, to be entangled, as hair.

f. (-टा)
1 The hair matted as worn by the god ŚIVA, and by ascetics; the long hairs occasionally clotted together, and brought over the head so as to project like a horn from the forehead, at other times allowed to fall carelessly over the back and shoulders.
2 The root of a tree, a fibrous root.
3 Spikenard: see जटामांसी.
4 A plant, (Asparagus racemosa.)
5 Cowach.
6 Hedysarum, various species.
E.
जट to entangle, अच् affix; or जन to be produced, टन् Uṇādi affix, and the radical final rejected.

m. (-टः)
1 A quantity of clotted hair.
2 ŚIVA'S hair.
E.
जटा, and जूट the same.

m. (-लः)
A lamp.
E.
जटा entangled hair, and ज्वाला flame.

m. (-ङ्कः)
ŚIVA.
E.
जटा as above, टकि to bind, affix अच्.

m. (-रः)
ŚIVA.
E.
जटा as above, अट to go, and ईरन् affix; some copies read जटाचीर.

m. (-रः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 A Jina or Jaina deified saint.
3 Any mendicant wearing the braid of hair.
E.
जटा entangled hair, and धर possessor; also with धारिन्, जटाधारिन् (-री.)

f. (-सी)
Indian spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.)
E.
जटा, entangled hair or root, and मांसी the same plant.

m. (-युः)
1 A fabulous bird, the son of ARUṆA, killed by RĀVAṆA.
2 Bdellium.
E.
जटा accumulation, आयु or आयुस् life; long-lived; hence also जटायुस् m. (-युः)

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Wearing clotted hair.
m. (-लः)
The Indian fig tree.
2 Zedoary.
3 Bdellium.
f. (-ला)
Spikenard: see जटामांसी.
E.
जटा as above, and लच् affix of possession.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having clotted hair.
f. (-ती)
Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansie.)
E.
जटा, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-टिः)
1 Waved-leaf fig tree, (F. venosa): see जटिन.
2 Assemblage, multitude.
2 Clotted hair: see जटा.
E.
जट to collect, affix इन्.

f. (-टी)
Waved-leaf fig tree: see जटि.
E.
जट to entangle, इ Uṇādi affix, and ङीष् added.

mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि)
Having clotted hair.
m. (-टी)
Wavedleaf fig tree: see जटि.
E.
जटा as above, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Having any clotted or entangled hair.
m. (-लः)
A lion.
f. (-ला)
1 Indian spikenard.
2 Long pepper.
3 Orris.
E.
जटा, and इलच् aff.

m. (-लः)
A freckle, a mark.
E.
जट to accumulate, उलच् affix; also जडुल.

mf. (-लिः-ली)
A plant, (Bignonia suave-olens); a various reading for पाटलि, q. v.
